description: AtScale query exporter: one JSON line per query (event atscale_query) or per aggregate suggestion (event atscale_uda_suggestion). Fields go under atscale.*, @timestamp is the query start.

script.description: Runtime bucket per query and join key (query id / fact dataset) for the Grafana tables; buckets match dashboard/generate.py
script.source: def a = ctx.atscale; if (a.event == 'atscale_query' && a.duration_ms != null) { double d = ((Number) a.duration_ms).doubleValue(); a.runtime_bucket = d < 1000 ? '1. under 1 s' : d < 5000 ? '2. 1 to 5 s' : d < 10000 ? '3. 5 to 10 s' : d < 30000 ? '4. 10 to 30 s' : '5. 30 s and more'; } if (a.event == 'atscale_uda_suggestion' && a.query_id != null && a.dataset != null) { a.join_key = a.query_id + '/' + a.dataset; }
